versions.changelog:
Initial release – Complete conversion copywriting toolkit for high-converting copy on any surface.

- Includes research methodology, 12 proven copywriting frameworks, swipe-file templates, scoring rubrics, and A/B testing protocols.
- Health check system to score and diagnose copy effectiveness across 8 key dimensions.
- Detailed Voice-of-Customer (VoC) mining and awareness-level guidance for precise message targeting.
- Structured copywriting briefs to clarify offers, audiences, and objections before writing.
- Step-by-step headline creation and evaluation system for maximum impact and relevance.
